_note: Brand marks shown on card faces, keyed by provider_id. A logo file (public/logos/<file>) is used only when it was taken from an official source recorded here with the date; otherwise the site renders a monogram. shape: wordmark (horizontal lockup, shown alone) or mark (symbol, shown next to the brand name). 'color' is the brand's own colour observed on the same official page (button or header colour); absent → default tint. Logos stay the trademarks of their owners and identify the products compared (nominative use); any removal request is honoured.
